description: Turns text (up to 1000 characters) into speech with a Cloudflare Workers AI TTS model, in English, Spanish, French or Japanese. Returns base64 audio as the model gives it. German and Turkish are not offered: the model used here does not list them. Requires the env.AI binding. Choose this tool for: Turns text into speech with a Cloudflare Workers AI TTS. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_speech_to_text_transcribe_turbo (Transcribes an audio file to text with a Cloudflare Workers); agent_intel_dnssec_trust_chain_validator (DNSSEC status for a domain using Cloudflare's public). Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

lang.description: en, es, fr or ja (default en)
